tavern.title: The Yawning Portal
tavern.description: Warm firelight and pipe smoke fill the Yawning Portal. Adventurers trade rumours over scarred tables while the great well yawns in the floor.

market.title: The Market
market.description: Stalls crowd the market square beneath awnings snapped by the wind. Merchants call prices over the splash of the fountain and the smell of spice and old stone.

cellar.title: The Cellar
cellar.description: Damp stone steps descend into a cellar thick with dust and old cobwebs. Casks and broken furniture crowd the walls, and the air holds a faint, sour chill.

warehouse.title: The Old Warehouse
warehouse.description: Dust hangs in the lantern light of the old warehouse. Crates and loading hooks fill the long floor, while the cult's marks still stain the beams.

vault.title: The Sealed Vault
vault.description: Cold iron and rune-carved stone frame the sealed vault. Every footstep echoes through the chamber, and the air tastes of metal and old magic.

road.title: The Trade Road
road.description: The Trade Road stretches east beneath a wide sky. Wind combs the grass at its edges, and the broken waystation rises at the far end of the route.

waystation.title: The Broken Waystation
waystation.description: The Broken Waystation leans against the road like a tired sentinel. Its palisade is patched, its campfire cold, and the strongbox waits in the shadow of the old walls.

underroad.title: The Underroad
underroad.description: A low tunnel runs beneath the waystation, its walls slick with seepage. Old lanterns and stacked crates mark the smugglers' route into the dark.

sanctum.title: The Sealed Sanctum
sanctum.description: Rune-light coils through the sealed sanctum. Black stone pillars rise around a silent hall where the air itself seems to hold its breath.
